profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Mentor Graphics
profile.summary: I am currently a Staff Software Engineer at Siemens Digital Industries Software with a broad skill set that includes C, C++, multithreaded programming and high performance computing.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead for the Calibre LVS product. Calibre LVS is a CAD tool that verifies that the physical layout matches the SPICE netlist description of the design. Calibre LVS has held the market leading position for over 20 years and is used by major IC design teams from around the world. C/C++ work targeted for Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior software engineer for the Calibre LVS product.

positions.title: Senior Member Technical Staff
positions.description: Developed software for IC physical design productivity. Contributed 18,000+ lines of code mostly in C++, C, tcl/tk and perl. Work was in linux with g++, gmake, STL, swig, svn. Consultant for integrated circuit physical design and implementation. Involved in all phases of IC physical design. (Floorplan, P&R, extraction, timing and physical verification). Tape out experience in 0.065 0.09, 0.18 and 0.25 (um).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched circuit technology using PD-SOI transistors. Published 2 IEEE papers and presented 1 conference paper at ICCAD 1999

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held recitations and lectures for circuits and devices.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Evaluated the latest wireless and network technologies suitable for the NYSE floor or for trade clearing systems.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Unix C programmer. Developed auto fax feature for call center software.
